question: A, B and C can all together do a piece of work in 10 days, in which B takes 3 times as long as A and C together to do the work. In how many days can B alone do the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B and C can all together do a piece of work in 10 days, in which B takes 3 times as long as A and C together to do the work. 

**Concept used:**

If A and B alone can complete a task in X and Y days respectively, then they together will take = XY/(X + Y) days to complete the work.
